review_scope: Inspected the accepted target, measurement overlay, final full-page render, side-by-side comparison and raw difference. Mechanical facts do not issue this decision.
reasoning_summary: Accepted for the editorial showcase after native-type, baseline and raster-boundary review.
observations: The three native title lines preserve the generated hierarchy, left alignment, spacing and overall visual mass. Bodoni 72 Book provides a close available serif interpretation, with small glyph-outline differences remaining visible in the difference image.
The subtitle and two footer labels remain native. Andale Mono preserves the observed monospace rhythm without the thin slab-serif appearance of the first Courier New render.

The artwork remains one editable image object. The hand contour, staircase edges and layered paper stay in their original region, and no conspicuous rectangular crop seam appears at the displayed scale.
remaining_limitations: The generated raster does not prove an exact font identity. Bodoni 72, Arial, Andale Mono and any italic substitute are declared available-font interpretations, and exact glyph contours differ.
Photographic collage, paper grain and intrinsic depicted marks remain raster within the documented regional image objects.
The quiet page field outside those image regions is a sampled native ivory fill. Fine source grain outside the collage is not reconstructed.

raster_evidence.observation: The selected source region remains legible at its final placement and retains intrinsic marks and paper edges.

visual_decision_basis: Host inspection of visible hierarchy, line breaks, baseline positions, crop boundaries and artwork retention. No similarity score.
